mod-count-rule.desc: Verifies that no `mod.rs` or `lib.rs` file declares more than a specified maximum number of modules (i.e. `mod` declarations).
mod-count-rule.rationale: To encourage a more nested and less flat codebase.

config.item: max - maximum `mod` declarations allowed per file (default 10).
ignore - list of module paths to skip (the directory containing the `mod.rs`/`lib.rs` the rule is for, relative to the project root, e.g. `src/app`).
